bundle.shortDescription: A fast desktop IDE for code, terminals, databases and AI agents
bundle.longDescription: Kodra is a desktop IDE built with Tauri v2 and Nuxt 3, featuring a code editor, terminal, git panel, debugger, SQL browser, in-app browser preview and an AI coding agent.
